description:
A formal European-style residential entry photographed at standing eye level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition, perfectly aligned to the central axis of the arched front doorway. The camera is level at approximately five feet, framing the full entry facade symmetrically from doorway to flanking urns.

The house exterior is smooth pale grey or warm white stucco finish — fine plaster with no texture variation. The entry is dominated by a dramatic full-height arched door surround with a classical arched pediment profile and dentil cornice — a sweeping round arch top with radiating fanlight glazing in a geometric sunburst pattern above the door frame. The arch reveal is rendered in bright white plaster against the grey stucco field.

The double front doors are painted deep matte black with divided-light glass panels in a grid pattern and a solid lower panel section, with classic polished brass lever hardware. A ring door knocker is centered on the right door.

Three stone entry steps lead up from the approach level, flanked by mortared fieldstone or cut limestone retaining walls forming the stair side walls. Fallen autumn leaves in rust and amber tones are scattered across the pale limestone or travertine step treads and surround pavers.

Floor-to-ceiling boxwood or cypress-style conical topiary trees in aged pewter-finish cast iron urn planters flank the doorway symmetrically on each side. Round-clipped boxwood globe shrubs grow at ground level in front of the urn bases.

Warm amber glows spill from two wall positions flanking the arch — one on each side — illuminating the pale plaster wall face and casting a golden bloom across the arched entry surround. The sky background is deep dusk blue-grey, making the lit entry glow with theatrical warmth. Decorative black-framed windows are visible at the far edges of the facade.
